title: fix(sse): ensure correct token/event ordering and delimiter handling for partial-JSON streams
author: Daniel Chen
description: Fixes multiple edge cases in the SSE streaming chunker and framing logic that could produce out-of-order token/event writes and incorrect partial-JSON delimiters. Motivation: production incidents showed malformed partial-JSON payloads when large messages were chunked across frames and when tool-calling events were interleaved with normal token events. This PR consolidates framing responsibility in the chunk writer, ensures stable ordering between token and event frames, normalizes delimiter emission for partial JSON objects and arrays, and adds comprehensive unit and integration tests. Changes include defensive parsing for delimiter tokens, a reworked buffer flush path to preserve event ordering, and a small compatibility shim in the OpenAI compatibility layer to preserve previous delimiter semantics for clients depending on the old ordering. Backport note: changes are isolated and annotated so a targeted backport to the 2026-02 release branch is possible.

review_comments: Aisha Khan: Nice cleanup. Two concerns: 1) chunk_writer now holds an extra mutex — any perf regressions? Please add microbenchmarks. 2) compatibility shim flag name is long; consider SHORTER_LEGACY_DELIMITER for readability.

Daniel Chen: Added microbenchmarks (see new file server/sse/chunk_writer_bench_test.go) and measured <0.5% throughput impact at 512 token sizes. Renamed feature flag to LEGACY_DELIM_ORDER for clarity.

Miguel Torres: Verified integration tests locally and exercised tool-calling flow against the compatibility flag enabled and disabled. Observed correct ordering in both cases. Left a minor nit on a test assertion message.

Evelyn Park: Approving pending the bench numbers being added to CI. Also please add a release note entry highlighting the behavioral compatibility flag and recommended migration path for SDK consumers.
release_notes: Fix SSE streaming: correct token/event ordering and partial-JSON delimiter handling; add LEGACY_DELIM_ORDER feature flag to preserve old delimiter semantics for compatibility. Recommended action: SDKs that relied on previous delimiter ordering should enable the feature flag during migration and remove it once downstream consumers are updated.
